title:
Easter - team Jacob’s join 🥚 🐣 

Every three months we meet up as a team for food and enjoy each other’s company, we always have a great selection of food, drinks and desserts 🎂

Today was an extra special one, as we surprised the Registered Manager - Vicky with some gifts, flowers and cards as she leaves us for a few weeks as she is getting married  💒 

#bluepitshousingaction #socialcare
#team #supportworker
